# Standard mileage or actual expenses: which deduction is bigger in 2026?

> Free 2026 business mileage deduction calculator for the self-employed: prices your miles at the IRS's split-year rates (72.5 cents through June 30, 76 cents from July 1) and compares standard mileage against actual vehicle expenses. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
